child.text:
[{"insert":"Aerobic Lower Body
 
This piece runs for fifteen minutes without stopping, cycling a three speed bike ramp into loaded lunges and hanging core work. The bike builds from easy to moderate to hard across ninety seconds, then you step off into the suitcase reverse lunge and the toes to bar. Break the lunges and the core work up as much as you need to keep the quality high. The pace should be one you can hold for the full fifteen minutes, so make sure you can still ride well on the last round.
"}]
